name: The academics
setupLines: Ingenious is sitting in Ingenuous's seat. Ingenuous hasn't noticed. Ingenuous never notices.
Genius is explaining footnotes to someone who didn't ask.
Something small in the corner has doubled in size since the soup.

genius: Genius has been keeping an eye on him. It's literally his job.
Ask Genius. He'll tell you anyway.
Genius says he knew Germ before he went bad.
genial: Genial thinks Germ is lovely. Ask her what she doesn't know.
Genial arranged half the marriages here. Ask her about his parents.
Ask Genial. She's the only one still smiling.
ingenious: Ingenious has a theory with a diagram.
Ask Ingenious. The clever one. No, the other clever one.
Ingenious found something in the Latin.
ingenuous: Ingenuous believes everything Germ told her. Ask what he told her.
Ask Ingenuous. She'll say yes to anything.
Ingenuous has been sitting in the wrong seat all night. She'll tell you everything.
